title: Returned-Payment Fee Relief After a Replacement Payment — PracticePay Patient Financing
content:
Under the returned-payment-fee relief schedule, which is one of the make-up relief schedules the courtesy-waiver rule names, a returned-payment fee is relieved once the payment that came back has been replaced after the return and the replacement has cleared, as one courtesy-basis waiver of that returned-payment fee entry, never more than the part of the fee not already waived. This schedule applies to every PracticePay Patient Financing plan.

**Last remaining courtesy waiver.** Where only one courtesy waiver remains within the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months in the rolling 12 months, the late-fee relief takes it only if one above 0.00 is owed on the plan's latest late fee, and otherwise the returned-payment-fee relief takes it.

**Ledger condition.** A returned-payment-fee relief is set only after the plan's ledger carries the late-fee relief owed on the plan's latest late fee, which takes a last remaining courtesy waiver first when it is above 0.00.

Restated: while the plan's ledger does not yet carry the late-fee relief owed on the plan's latest late fee, no returned-payment-fee relief is set.

A payment that came back without having been credited toward a monthly due date is never replaced, and its fee is not relieved under this schedule. A returned-payment-fee relief that works out to 0.00 is not owed, and nothing is booked for it.

## Booking tool: `relieve_returned_payment_fee_3fbe4785`

**Capability.** Books one waiver entry on the plan's ledger, dated today, on the courtesy basis, naming the returned-payment fee entry it relieves, and lowers the plan balance by the amount relieved. The patient sees the relief on the plan's ledger and in the lower balance.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `relieve_returned_payment_fee_3fbe4785` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `pos_plan_id` | reference number of the PracticePay plan, as returned by the PracticePay plan lookup | identifier |
| `related_txn_id` | reference number of the returned-payment fee entry being relieved, as shown by the PracticePay ledger lookup for that plan | identifier |
| `relief_amount` | the amount relieved | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount; stored rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `pos_txn_id` (reference number of the waiver entry), `pos_plan_id`, `related_txn_id` (the returned-payment fee entry relieved), `relief_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `waiver_reason` (the courtesy basis the entry is booked on), `relief_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `plan_balance` (the plan balance after the relief, USD with 2 decimal places). A `pos_txn_id` in the receipt means the relief is booked.
